summary.text: Bud Cook is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for the 50th Legislative District.
He was first elected in November 2016 to the 49th District and, after redistricting, to the new 50th District in 2023.

paragraphs.text: Cook's official biography calls him a lifelong businessman and says he graduated from California Area High School, worked three jobs to pay his own tuition and earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia Wesleyan College.
After college he served two terms as a city councilman in Buckhannon, West Virginia, before returning to southwestern Pennsylvania.
He has been a self-employed business owner for more than 30 years across several businesses.

For the 2023-24 session, his biography says, he was appointed to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Environmental Resources and Energy, and Tourism and Economic and Recreational Development committees, and was to serve as Republican secretary of the Agriculture Committee.
It says he spearheaded the "Come Home, Go Big and Have a Ball" initiative to bring people back to Greene and Washington Counties and the southwest region.
